items.title: Alibaba Seeks $10 Billion From Share Sale for AI Expansion
items.summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. is seeking to raise about HK$80 billion ($10.2 billion) from a share sale, its latest move to compete for global leadership in artificial intelligence.

items.title: Mystery AI Model Ox Alpha Draws Developers With Free Access
items.summary: A new artificial intelligence model called Ox Alpha is gaining traction among developers after appearing online for free, even as the identity of its creator remains a mystery.

items.title: Mexican Governor Wanted by US Over Cartel Ties Seeks Leave Again
items.summary: The Mexican governor accused by the US of conspiring with a cartel and abetting drug trafficking has once again requested leave, after returning to his post on Friday.

items.title: Nvidia customers reportedly warned about AI-related price hikes
